title: Improper scaling when lowering "Display Size" (DPI) - Android 7.0+
symptom: When changing Android display size from Default to Small, the app's Status Line text does not scale properly and appears to at least double in size, making it impossible to add multiple extra Status Line items.
evidence_quote: However, when you change the display size from Default to Small, the app (and more specifically the Status Line text) does not scale properly at all; the size of the Status Line text appears to at least double.
